overlaps.detail: Both specify finite-dimensional Frobenius/symmetric-functional structures and self-injectivity. StablePeriodicCurved is the general functional/right-dual interface; ZigzagPreprojective computes the trace on a specific path-algebra quotient, over every field. The target boundary calls zigzag traces examples, not prerequisites for the general construction.
overlaps.proposal: Keep the roadmaps separate. Coordinate one general Frobenius-functional predicate and its symmetric refinement with explicit left/right opposite adapters. Zigzag owns basis nondegeneracy, low-rank exceptions and trace calculations; StablePeriodicCurved owns generic module/stable machinery. Do not add both generic-to-example and example-to-generic stage edges, or make generic exact categories depend on zigzag calculations. Concurrent PR #463 already proposes the generic Layer 0 -> Zigzag Layer 2 dependency (packet blob 19afc141d310a1fb36cc37abfae4134706e0f123); reuse that proposal rather than emit a duplicate edge. This overlap documents the generic/example boundary and does not oppose that narrow reuse route.

overlaps.detail: Both use bounded derived categories, but the supplier only handles the stated abelian bounded-complex/K0 comparisons and explicitly excludes constructing the derived category of a general Quillen exact category. StablePeriodicCurved Layer 2 needs the latter for the Keller–Vossieck comparison.
overlaps.proposal: Retain general exact-acyclic localization, D^b(E) and its quotient comparison in StablePeriodicCurved Layer 2. Reuse exact structures from GrothendieckEulerForms Layer 0 and any applicable abelian localization baseline, without presenting GrothendieckEulerForms Layer 2 as a supplier of D^b(E). No unrestricted replacement by K^b(E)/K^b(P), and no reverse dependency in the foundational roadmap.

overlaps.detail: Second-kind derived-category language occurs in both. StablePeriodicCurved constructs absolute/co/contra closures and comparison functors for curved right modules, with an abstract triangulated closure tool. DGAInfinity Layer 11 requests derived/coderived Koszul equivalences under conilpotence, boundedness and duality hypotheses; its coalgebraic carriers are not automatically the same module category.
overlaps.proposal: Coordinate and reuse the abstract closure/localization tool where its hypotheses fit, but retain the respective module and coalgebra instantiations and equivalence proofs. Before adding a directed edge, specify a common carrier, the generating totalizations, required products or coproducts, and the handedness adapter. Do not substitute the curved graded-global-dimension comparison for a conilpotent Koszul-duality theorem.
